currentTaskEffect: Prepare repo-ready code/private-runtime package and explicit deployment bridge; no deployment inferred
rule: A stage does not imply the next. Local package success never auto-closes deployment gates. Operator records dated exact-target evidence.

gates.name: Source syntax/private-boundary/closed-capability checks
gates.requiredEvidence: Run source check and record exact output

gates.name: Synthetic authentication/boundary/content test suite
gates.requiredEvidence: Run tests on selected Node 24 runtime; record command/runtime/results

gates.name: Code-only image build
gates.requiredEvidence: Resolve image digest; build without evidence; inspect image/build context
evidence: Dockerfile and context allowlist statically inspected; CI and target host run actual image build.

gates.name: Repository and branch identity/visibility
gates.requiredEvidence: Record chosen repository, branch, inspected diff and code-only push

gates.name: Private payload integrity and file permissions
gates.requiredEvidence: Verify exact manifest, private runtime path, owner and access permissions

gates.name: Named account provisioning and custody
gates.requiredEvidence: Create enabled unexpired accounts; approve whole included dossier for each; deliver credentials privately

gates.name: TLS/DNS/ingress integration
gates.requiredEvidence: Review/merge ingress fragment, validate/reload actual proxy, verify certificate renewal and uncached response headers

gates.name: No direct origin or trusted-header bypass
gates.requiredEvidence: Prove upstream is loopback only; test missing/wrong key, Host, proto and external origin paths

gates.name: Existing same-origin website XSS/security review
gates.requiredEvidence: Inspect whole-origin scripts, user-controlled content, dependencies and CSP; document resolution

gates.name: Existing service-worker scope review
gates.requiredEvidence: Inspect code and actual registrations; remove/restrict workers controlling portal path; verify no residual interception/cache

gates.name: Live authenticated/anonymous route smoke checks
gates.requiredEvidence: Confirm anonymous byte/text/range/HEAD requests fail and authenticated bytes match manifest

gates.name: Revocation and restart exercise
gates.requiredEvidence: Stop for urgent revocation; disable test account in operator-owned source and redeploy its new protected snapshot; verify disabled login fails, all old sessions are revoked and a permitted account can sign in. Plain restart alone must not be represented as account disable. Exercise failed deployment/rollback so an older enabled account snapshot cannot silently undo revocation. Verify changed approved account or edge-key state stops the previous service before build and disables automatic incompatible fallback.

gates.name: Operational log retention/privacy
gates.requiredEvidence: Inspect proxy/Docker/app logs; exclude secrets/private content; configure bounded rotation and retention policy

gates.name: Backup and clean restore exercise
gates.requiredEvidence: Restore encrypted isolated backup to clean private location; compare hashes and verify synthetic login/protected routes Reconcile latest account revocations/expiry and current ingress key before restart; do not reactivate historical access.

gates.name: Accessibility and recipient environment
gates.requiredEvidence: Keyboard/screen-reader/zoom/mobile/PDF/enterprise-network check and workable alternative access route

gates.name: Runtime/image/host/proxy update review
gates.requiredEvidence: Record tested image digest and host/runtime/proxy versions and current advisory review

gates.name: Accurate assurance and receipt statements
gates.requiredEvidence: Retain no certification/zero-day/full-native-framework/official-receipt claim; update only with bounded evidence

gates.name: Material source/provider/runtime/AI capability change
gates.requiredEvidence: Freeze scope, reassess risks, rerun affected checks, keep rollback and operator decision receipt

claimRestrictions: No unknown-vulnerability or zero-day elimination claim
No ISO conformity or certification claim
No full native framework execution claim
No official receipt/acceptance/record linkage inferred from HTTP events
No production effectiveness claim before observation
